method: At 512-bit precision, Arb encloses every entry of the 100-mode head block of DT at the polynomial centre and its interval matrix square; l1 norms are rigorous column suprema. The omitted input and output blocks are bounded by weighted composition majorants at sigma=1.38, and the centre-to-fixed-point correction uses ||D^2T||<=223.77 and ||G-G0||_1<=1e-20. The square is bounded by the resulting 2x2 head/tail block product, followed by the rigorous perturbation bound (2||A0||+eps)eps.
